Reported at: 8:23AM 12/26/2023

Good Morning Winter Enthusiasts!

The temperature is 26deg under cloudy skies at 6am. We received 4" of new snow that started out warm and progressively got colder overnight. the forecast is calling partly cloudy day becoming cloudy during the afternoon.

Ski Hill will offer groomed Alpine and Tubing for out door snow fun. The Lodge will offer warm fire and tasty hot meals all day.

The Golf Course is open for sledding only today. 

the Icicle River Trail are going to be track packed this morning to see if we can put the tiller down and groom it out. The snow is really thin out there as it is less protected then the SH Alpine form the sun and trails were mostly dirt on Sunday.<
